opening.argument: The page presents an ordinary Sephora e-gift-card purchase workflow, with a card preview, design choices, message area, amount selection, and email delivery fields. It asks for recipient and purchaser information and provides “Add To Cart” and “Check Out” controls, showing routine ecommerce customization and checkout rather than a financial-return mechanism or a request for credentials. The title identifies “sephora.com e-gift cards,” further tying the material to a retail product. The evidence does not establish what happened at checkout or what external service conditions applied, so the claim remains limited to the ordinary purchasing process shown.
